defects_discovered_and_fixed.description: CCEE error parsing log logged raw response string, presenting potential privacy leak risk during malformed JSON parsing.
defects_discovered_and_fixed.fix: Sanitized error log and exception message to omit raw text payload.

defects_discovered_and_fixed.description: Async context generation and note fetch lacked request-identity and patient-identity guard, presenting a risk of stale Patient A data rendering if user switched to Patient B while a request was in flight.
defects_discovered_and_fixed.fix: Introduced activeRequestIdRef and activePatientIdRef guards across handleGenerate, fetchDoctorNotes, and handleSaveNote.
defects_discovered_and_fixed.verification: frontend build succeeded; stale responses verified discarded.

defects_discovered_and_fixed.description: Patient conversational assistants lacked an explicit conversation closure and data minimization policy, occasionally prompting open-ended follow-up questioning after user concerns were already addressed.
defects_discovered_and_fixed.fix: Added DATA MINIMIZATION & CONVERSATION CLOSURE POLICY to NUTRITION_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION and MENTAL_WELLNESS_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION with safety crisis exceptions.
defects_discovered_and_fixed.verification: test_07 through test_11 in test_day17_hardening.py passed.

checks.detail: Controlled 422 responses on empty, null, whitespace, or invalid types.
Handled up to 14 KB inputs without memory corruption, crash, or unbounded logs.
Trimmed patient IDs and cleaned whitespace consistently across storage and API.
Tamil, accented Latin, emoji, and special characters preserved accurately.
Natural conversational conclusion; maximum 1 targeted follow-up; crisis escalation preserved.
Doctor Context causes 0 writes on repeated clicks; Doctor Notes append-only.
Unsupported HTTP verbs return 405 Method Not Allowed without state mutation.
Stateless service and repositories maintain strict isolation under interleaved execution.
.env is gitignored, .env.example contains only placeholders, 0 committed keys.
Compound indexes verified for patient_context and doctor_notes; controlled 500 on DB failure.
Zero database mutations occur upon executing Doctor Context AI assistance.

known_prototype_limitations: No clinician or patient authentication / RBAC.
Patient ID is a prototype session identifier.
Timestamps represent PCIF database persistence time.
No clinical validation or diagnostic certification.
